parsedVerdict.reasoning: ClaimController.ts fits the presentation layer. It declares a request body DTO (FileClaimBody) and a controller. The controller's constructor injects FileClaim and SettleClaim, both application use cases, which is allowed dependency wiring. The file() method copies body fields into arguments, turns the incidentOn string into a Date, passes everything to the use case and wraps the result in a response object. settle() simply forwards to the use case. That is ordinary request/response translation. The file holds no domain invariant, calculation or decision. The clone flags only point to similar code in PolicyController, which is a duplication concern. They do not show any declaration that belongs to another layer, so they don't count against the unit.
